select d.doc_id as docId, d.library_id as libraryId, d.dept_id as deptId, d.title, d.category, d.graph_enabled as graphEnabled, d.current_version as currentVersion, d.update_time as updateTime, active.version_id as currentVersionId, latest.version_id as latestVersionId, latest.version as latestVersion, coalesce(active.filename, latest.filename) as filename, active.chars, parse.status as parseStatus, parse.error as parseError, embedding.status as embedStatus, embedding.error as embedError, graph.status as graphStatus, graph.error as graphError from kb_document d left join kb_document_version active on active.active_doc_id = d.doc_id left join kb_document_version latest on latest.version_id = ( select max(v.version_id) from kb_document_version v where v.doc_id = d.doc_id and v.deleted_at is null ) left join kb_ingest_task parse on parse.version_id = latest.version_id and parse.stage = 'parse' left join kb_ingest_task embedding on embedding.version_id = active.version_id and embedding.stage = 'embed' left join kb_ingest_task graph on graph.version_id = active.version_id and graph.stage = 'graph'
